title: Financial Assistance Policy, Section 8 — FAP Liability and the Charity Adjustment
content:
**8.1** Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), for each covered encounter the award books one charity adjustment.

**8.2 Charge basis.** The FAP charge basis is, for a self-pay encounter, the amounts-generally-billed amount — the amounts-generally-billed percentage of the encounter's gross charges, rounded half-up to the cent; for an insured encounter, the total patient responsibility posted from the payer.

**8.3 FAP liability.** The FAP liability is the charge basis times one minus the tier's discount percent, rounded half-up to the cent; under medical hardship it is the charge basis limited to what remains of the hardship liability cap after the liabilities already booked on the case.

**8.4 Obligation and adjustment.** The patient's obligation before assistance is the encounter's current patient balance plus the patient payments already applied to it. The charity adjustment is that obligation less the FAP liability; when the obligation does not exceed the FAP liability, no adjustment is booked.

**8.5 Credit balance.** When payments already applied exceed the FAP liability, the adjustment leaves a credit balance on the encounter, which is refunded under the hospital-account refund rule after the refund review.

**8.6** The uninsured discount and any prompt-pay or courtesy adjustment already posted stay in place and are part of the obligation calculation, never reversed.

### Worked example (hypothetical self-pay encounter, 80 percent discount tier, amounts-generally-billed percentage taken as 34.6 percent)

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Gross charges | 10,000.00 |
| Charge basis: 34.6 percent of gross charges | 3,460.00 |
| FAP liability: 3,460.00 times one minus 80 percent | 692.00 |
| Current patient balance | 2,000.00 |
| Patient payments already applied | 1,000.00 |
| Obligation before assistance: balance plus payments | 3,000.00 |
| Charity adjustment: obligation less FAP liability | 2,308.00 |

Because the 1,000.00 already paid exceeds the 692.00 FAP liability, the adjustment leaves a credit balance of 308.00 on the encounter.
